closing.summary: So Bacon still has real protein quality, useful vitamin B12, a little zinc, and a strong flavour role. But saturated fat, low vitamin D, low iron, heavy sodium, processing, and portion creep pull it down hard. It is best as a small flavour tool or occasional comfort-food add-on, not as a core everyday protein.

scenes.narrationText: 37.1 grams of fat. The bright spot is 5.8 grams of polyunsaturated fat, which helps balance the fat profile.
